❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Why is 23 the magic number?
23 people form 253 pairs, and the no-match probability (364/365)×(363/365)×… drops just below 50% — so a match is likelier than not.
Is this about matching MY birthday?
No — that needs ~253 people for 50%. The paradox is about ANY two people sharing a birthday.
Does it assume 365 days?
Yes, leap days are ignored and birthdays are treated as uniform — the standard textbook model.
